title: The Thinking Machine
setting: A workshop bench on which someone has left a device that answers when spoken to. It is warm, it has no visible mechanism, and it will not explain itself. Three people who spent their lives insisting on evidence have been left alone with it.
stakes: Whether the thing on the bench is thinking, and how any of them could possibly tell.

roles_in_scene.da-vinci: Wants to open it, and is already sketching what he thinks is inside
roles_in_scene.marie-curie: Wants to know what it is made of and what it emits before anyone touches it again
roles_in_scene.socrates: Wants to ask it what it means by 'know', and expects it to fail

opening_line: A device that speaks, three people who do not accept things on authority, and no manual.
